tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Light theme is the paper of a developed print.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs and raised panels on `ground`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on `ground`, `surface` and `blush`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy and captions on `ground` and `surface`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card borders. Not for control outlines.

tokens.name: control-line
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button outlines on `ground` and `surface`.

tokens.name: curtain
tokens.usage: The brand colour. Primary buttons, links on `ground`, the logo, one big section per page.

tokens.name: flash
tokens.usage: The accent. Highlights, badges, the logo's lens. Use small; never as text on `ground`.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Soft tinted sections and selected states, under `ink` text.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The one hero headline on a page. Step down to `h1` size on phones.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Open the booth, squeeze in, and get your strip in seconds.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Take four shots and share them with the group.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside buttons and between labels and fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gaps between grid items.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and chips, echoing the logo's round lens.
